title: Taking Care Of Me Worksheets | K–2nd Social Studies Practice with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Supports social-emotional learning (CASEL competencies)

Give your learners extra practice with Taking Care Of Me! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Take Care of Me
  • Healthy Habit or Not?
  • Leo Gets Ready for Bed
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Take Care of Me, Healthy Habit or Not?, Leo Gets Ready for Bed), so children can play, then print and practice
